name: Four Seasons Hotel Washington, DC
positioning: Hotel on Pennsylvania Avenue in historic Georgetown, overlooking the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal
best_for: Guests who want a base in Georgetown
Guests traveling with a dog or cat

facts.text: It was the first hotel in the United States to open under the Four Seasons name.
The hotel is in historic Georgetown on Pennsylvania Avenue, overlooking the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal.
The hotel is just 12 blocks from the White House.
The hotel is steps from the Kennedy Center.
Seasons restaurant is known for its iconic "power breakfast".
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
Premium Wi-Fi is a complimentary service.

highlights.text: The Georgetown Suite with Terrace is a fifth-floor suite with sweeping views of the C&O Canal and the Potomac River.
The Royal Suite has a private terrace overlooking 29th Street.
The art on display includes works by Andy Warhol, Helen Frankenthaler and Fernando Botero.
The hotel has an underground lap pool tucked beneath Georgetown.
The spa has a private Contrast Therapy Room with a cold plunge and infrared sauna.
The hotel is pet-friendly, welcoming dogs and cats with no weight restrictions.

considerations.text: The complimentary sedan service is only for drop-offs anywhere within DC, not Virginia or Maryland.
The walk to the White House down Pennsylvania Avenue takes about 30 minutes.
WhataHotel notes the Georgetown location may require travel to reach major DC monuments.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
